verdict.rationale: Hightouch Events documents an HTTP Tracking API for server-side ingestion, including a batch endpoint for submitting multiple events in one request, so the core server-to-server ingestion path exists. The bearer-token authentication in the evidence belongs to the management REST API, not the events collector, so it does not carry over. Nothing in the pack describes delivery guarantees such as retries, acknowledgements or deduplication. Missing for 10: documented authentication for the events HTTP API, documented delivery guarantees (retries/acks/idempotency), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can send events server-to-server through a documented HTTP ingestion API with authentication and delivery guarantees

citations.quote: plus an HTTP API for server-side ingestion
Hightouch's HTTP Tracking API enables you to record data from any website or application.
Use the batch endpoint to submit multiple events to the collector in a single request.
